items.title: Why DeJounte Murray Tells NBA Players To Stay Inside
items.author: ALL THE SMOKE
items.body_excerpt: 𝐀𝐋𝐋 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐒𝐌𝐎𝐊𝐄 𝐆𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐓𝐄𝐒𝐓 𝐇𝐈𝐓𝐒: 𝐃𝐀𝐘 𝟐𝟓 DeJounte Murray learned early to keep the distractions away. His message to other NBA players: it's ok to stay inside and skip the clubs.
